intro.text: A campaign is a series of linked games. At least 2 players are needed; games may also be played against non-campaign players. Each player recruits a starting Warband (see Warbands of Trench Crusade) and then picks a Patron. The Patron determines which skill may be chosen when a Patron Skill result is rolled on any Skill Table.

skills.name: Armour & Equipment Procurement
skills.text: Cost of any Armour, Shield or Equipment worth 15 ducats or more is reduced by 5 ducats if a model with this Skill is in the Warband when it is purchased.

skills.name: Melee Weapon Procurement
skills.text: Cost of any Melee Weapon worth 10 ducats or more is reduced by 5 ducats if the model with this Skill is in the Warband when it is purchased.

skills.name: Mendelist Chemicals
skills.text: Opposing player cannot spend BLOOD MARKERS next to this model to add +1 INJURY DICE (they may still use them to convert to a Bloodbath Roll).

skills.name: Ranged Weapon Procurement
skills.text: Cost of any Ranged Weapon or Grenade worth 20 ducats or more is reduced by 5 ducats if a model with this Skill is in the Warband when it is purchased.

skills.name: Sniper School
skills.text: Ranged Attacks by this model need 1 less BLOOD MARKER to convert an Injury Roll to a Bloodbath Roll.

skills.name: Special Assault Training
skills.text: Melee Attacks by this model need 1 less BLOOD MARKER to convert an Injury Roll to a Bloodbath Roll.

skills.name: Blessings of the Warrior Saint
skills.text: Model gains the BLESSED D3 Keyword.

skills.name: David and Goliath
skills.text: +1 DICE to a Melee Attack by this model if the target is on a 40mm or larger base.

skills.name: Dragonslayer
skills.text: When making an Injury Roll for a Melee Attack by this model, you may change one of the D6s used to a 6.

skills.name: Endure the Suffering
skills.text: Model can suffer 1 extra Battle Scar before being unfit for duty.

skills.name: On your Knees!
skills.text: Enemy models that are Down may not stand up while within 1” of this model (even if this model is also Down).

skills.name: Warrior's Prayer ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Risky Success Roll. Failure: nothing, Activation ends. Success/Critical: model has FEAR until end of Turn and you may remove up to 1 BLOOD MARKER from it.

skills.name: Favoured by God
skills.text: At the end of each game, Warband gains 1 additional glory for each model with this Skill on the battlefield.

skills.name: Healing Arts
skills.text: You may re-roll the Trauma Table result for this model.

skills.name: Knowledge of Sciences
skills.text: The Limit of one chosen item of Battlekit (excluding Glory Items) is increased by 1 while a model with this Skill is in the Warband. Record the chosen Battlekit on the roster.

skills.name: Logistical Skills
skills.text: Warband may increase any model-count Limit by 1 (e.g. 0-2 becomes 0-3) for models that are not ELITE, not on a 50mm+ base, and not Mercenaries. If the model with this Skill is removed, excess models are kept but no new models may be added in excess of normal limits.

skills.name: Pennies from Heaven
skills.text: At the end of each game, Warband gains D6x5 additional ducats for each model with this Skill on the battlefield.

skills.name: Walk with God
skills.text: Pick one Skill from any Skill Table available to the model, including any Exploration Skill, and give it to this model.

skills.name: 30 Pieces of Silver
skills.text: At the end of each game, Warband gains D6x5 ducats for each model with this Skill on the battlefield.

skills.text: If a Melee Attack by this model takes an enemy Out of Action, place 1 BLESSING MARKER next to this model.

skills.name: Blood Sacrifice ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Success Roll. On Success/Critical, remove 1 BLOOD MARKER from this model and place it next to any other model within 6” and in line of sight that does not have ARTIFICIAL, BLACK GRAIL or DEMONIC.

skills.name: Hellfire ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Risky Success Roll. Failure: nothing, Activation ends. Success/Critical: pick a friendly model within 18” and in line of sight; draw a 1mm-wide straight line between the closest points of the two bases and make an Injury Roll with FIRE for every model (friend or foe) crossed or reached, including the chosen friendly model but not the acting model.

skills.name: Lash of Acheron ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Risky Success Roll. Failure: nothing, Activation ends. Success/Critical: make an Injury Roll with IGNORE ARMOUR against 1 enemy model within 6” and in line of sight.

skills.name: Sadistic
skills.text: +1 DICE and +1 INJURY DICE to Melee Attacks by this model if the target is Down.

skills.name: Güreş
skills.text: +1 DICE and +1 INJURY DICE to Melee Attacks by this model if the target is Down. This model ignores the -1 DICE modifier to Success Rolls for being Down.

skills.name: Imported Wares

skills.name: Janissary Training
skills.text: If the first ACTION of this model's Activation is a Charge, +1 DICE to its Melee Attacks for the rest of the Activation. Model also has IGNORE OFF-HAND WEAPON.

skills.name: Rightly Guided

skills.name: Sultan's Favour
skills.text: Warband may increase any model-count Limit by 1 (e.g. 0-2 becomes 0-3) for models that are not ELITE, not on a 50mm+ base, and not Mercenaries. If the model with this Skill is removed, excess models are kept but no new models may be added in excess of normal limits.

skills.name: Sword of Allah

skills.name: Cockroach Vitality
skills.text: Opposing player cannot spend BLOOD MARKERS next to this model to add +1 INJURY DICE for a Melee or Ranged Attack.

skills.name: Deceit of Beelzebub ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Risky Success Roll. Failure: nothing, Activation ends. Success/Critical: pick an enemy model within 8” and swap the positions of the two models (base centres exchanged). If impossible (impassable terrain, other models), both stay put.

skills.name: Eyes of the Fly
skills.text: Model has IGNORE COVER and IGNORE LONG RANGE.

skills.name: Grail Plague
skills.text: At the start of each game after deployment, for each model with this Skill on the battlefield, place 1 INFECTION MARKER next to an enemy model without BLACK GRAIL.

skills.name: Knight of the Flies
skills.text: -1 DICE to Ranged Attacks that target this model.

skills.name: Wings of the Fly
skills.text: Model gains FLYING if it does not already have it.

patrons.name: Mammon

skills.name: Aureate Skin
skills.text: Each time a BLOOD MARKER is placed next to this model, add 5 ducats to your treasury.

skills.name: Crooked Dice
skills.text: Once per game, re-roll all dice of a Success Roll for this model, or all dice of an Injury Roll for an attack made by this model.

skills.name: Plutocracy

skills.name: Unsecured Loan

skills.name: Beelzebub's Wisdom

skills.name: Eye of Beelzebub ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Success Roll. Failure: nothing. Success/Critical: pick an enemy model within 24”, in Cover, and not within 1” of your models; opponent must move it 1” so it stays in line of sight but is no longer in Cover and is more than 1” from your models. If impossible, it is not moved.

skills.name: Feast on Disease
skills.text: If the target of this model's Melee Attack has 1+ INFECTION MARKERS, converting the Injury Roll to a Bloodbath Roll costs 1 less BLOOD MARKER or INFECTION MARKER.

skills.name: Infect the Mind

skills.name: Silvered Tongue ACTION
skills.text: ACTION: Success Roll. Failure: nothing. Success/Critical: pick an enemy model within 1”; it must make one Melee Attack against itself (you choose the weapon if it has more than one). Only one attack regardless of its normal number.

skills.name: Swine Hybrid
skills.text: Add 2” to this model's Movement Characteristic.

campaignGames.text: A campaign links individual games. Arrange a game with any other campaign player, select the scenario (see Selecting a Campaign Scenario), play with normal rules, then carry out a Campaign Phase. After 11 campaign games a player may play no more until every other player has also played 11. Each player then plays a final 12th game against another player using The Great War scenario. With an odd number of players one player plays an extra 13th game against the odd player and chooses whether the 12th or 13th result (not both) counts for Campaign Victory Points.
campaignGames.oddPlayerRule: One player plays an extra 13th game; they choose which of game 12 or 13 counts.
campaignGames.lengthVariants: Players may change the number of games before the Final Battle (e.g. 4-5 for a weekend; 23 at 2 games/month for a year).

victoryPoints.text: Campaign Victory Points are scored per game and tracked on the Warband Roster. Most points at campaign end wins; ties are joint winners.

latecomers.text: A player joining in progress recruits using the Warband Threshold Value of the player who has played the most games, and receives 4 Experience Points per game that top player has played, divided between ELITE models as the latecomer sees fit.

scenarioSelection.text: Count games played so far and roll on the matching table. If players have played different numbers of games, use the greater number to choose the table. Pick & Choose option: after rolling, if both players agree they may swap the rolled scenario for another from the same table (e.g. when terrain or table size is unavailable).

table.result: Player who has played fewer games chooses from this table; if tied, roll-off and winner chooses.
Player who has played fewer games chooses from this table; if tied, roll-off and winner chooses.

campaignForces.text: The models used in a campaign game are a Force. Threshold Value: total Cost of all models in the Force (including Battlekit, upgrades paid in ducats, and any Cost discounts) must be less than or equal to the Warband's Threshold Value. Field Strength: number of models in the Force may not exceed Field Strength; a scenario model limit lower than Field Strength takes precedence. Only models with a Warband Entry count; models representing Battlekit or Glory Items do not. Both values increase after each game per the Warband Threshold Table; rising values grant nothing automatically — recruit or call Reinforcements. Models left out of a Force sit the game out and earn no experience.
rules: Force total Cost <= Threshold Value (includes Battlekit, ducat-paid upgrades, and discounts).
Force model count <= Field Strength; scenario limits override when lower.
Only Warband Entry models count toward Field Strength; Battlekit/Glory Item models (e.g. Trench Dog) do not.
Models not fielded earn no Experience and cannot influence the game.

warbandThreshold.text: Threshold Value and Field Strength by game number. Values are indexed by the game about to be played.

gloriousDeeds.text: Every scenario lists Glorious Deeds. Track which models carried out which Deeds each game. Each Deed can be carried out once per game but may be repeated in different games.
effects: +1 Victory Point toward winning the game.
ELITE models that carry out any Glorious Deed receive 1 Experience Point (one, regardless of how many Deeds).
+1 D6 to the Promotion Pool after the game for each Glorious Deed carried out.

gloryPoints.text: Each Glorious Deed in a campaign earns the Warband 1 glory, recorded on the Warband Roster. Glory is spent in the Quartermaster Step; unspent glory may be banked for later. One-off games: players may agree to allow glory when building Warbands for a one-off game, spent as in the Quartermaster Step.
uses: Purchase Battlekit or models from the Faction List that have a Cost in glory rather than ducats.
Purchase Glory Items (see Purchase Glory Items).
Recruit Mercenaries (see Mercenaries in Warbands of Trench Crusade).

campaignPhase.text: After each campaign game both players carry out a Campaign Phase, working through the steps in order.

steps.name: Trauma Step
steps.text: Determine what happened to models taken Out of Action.

steps.name: Promotions & Experience Step
steps.text: Promote Troops, record Experience Points, check for new Skills.

steps.name: Reinforcements Step
steps.text: Optionally call for reinforcements after heavy losses. Doing so forfeits the Exploration and Quartermaster Steps.

steps.name: Exploration Step
steps.text: Roll to see what the Warband discovers in the area it occupies.

steps.name: Quartermaster Step
steps.text: Recruit, hire Mercenaries, sell/purchase/reallocate Battlekit and Glory Items.

steps.name: Roster Step
steps.text: Update the Warband Roster with all changes.

campaignPhase.disbanding: A Warband may be disbanded at the end of any game; the replacement starts as a latecomer (see Latecomers to Campaign).

traumaTable.text: Troops (non-ELITE) taken Out of Action make a Survival Roll: D6, on 1-2 they are removed from the roster (dead), on 3+ they fight on. ELITE models taken Out of Action then roll D66 (first D6 = tens, second = units) on the Trauma Table. Removed models lose all Battlekit unless stated otherwise. Battle Scars: unless stated otherwise, each time an ELITE model is taken Out of Action it receives a Battle Scar (some results say no Scar). Unfit for Duty: on the third Battle Scar the model is removed; its Battlekit and Glory Items go to the Arsenal unless a rule says they cannot be removed. A model can suffer each type of Injury only once; if the same Injury is rolled again, re-roll until a usable result (exception: Lost an Eye a second time = blinded, removed). Modifiers: Healing Arts (Learned Saint) and 'Tis But a Scratch (Wildcard) allow a re-roll; Resurrection Engine (Glory Item) changes a result to Full Recovery; Endure the Suffering, War-Luck and Damascus Armour raise the Battle Scar limit; Eternal Debt (Mammon) gives Wretched automatic Full Recovery; Field Hospital / Curative Fluids / Salvaged Resurrection Machine can remove Battle Scars later.

rows.name: Dead
rows.effect: Remove the model and its Battlekit from the roster.

rows.name: Captured
rows.effect: Opponent captures the model. Players negotiate a ransom in ducats before continuing the Trauma Step. Not paid: model executed, remove from roster. Paid: transfer the ducats from your Strongbox to the opponent's and treat as Full Recovery.

rows.name: Severe Nerve Damage
rows.effect: All Success Rolls for this model are treated as Risky Success Rolls (no extra penalty if already Risky).

rows.name: Hand Wound
rows.effect: Randomly determine the injured hand. -1 DICE to attacks with a Melee Weapon held (or jointly held) by that hand.

rows.name: Lost an Eye
rows.effect: -1 DICE to Ranged Attacks by this model. A second Lost an Eye blinds the model: remove from roster instead of re-rolling. Treat as Full Recovery for a Sniper Priest.

rows.name: Chest Wound
rows.effect: +1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for attacks targeting this model.

rows.name: Insomniac
rows.effect: Must always be the first model you deploy in any game it takes part in; loses INFILTRATOR if it has it.

rows.name: Head Wound
rows.effect: Can no longer gain Experience Points. May be assigned Promotion Dice as if a Troop; if one of its assigned dice rolls a 6 it regains the ability to gain Experience (Battle Scar remains).

rows.name: Shell-shocked
rows.effect: Roll a D6 the first time this model is deployed in a game; on 1-2, -1 DICE to all rolls for this model for the rest of that game.

rows.name: Dark Memory
rows.effect: Record the Warband from the game where received. -1 DICE to Melee Attacks by this model against models from that Warband.

rows.name: Paranoid
rows.effect: Cannot be deployed within 8” of a friendly model; friendly models may be deployed within 8” of it after it is deployed.

rows.name: Lost Arm
rows.effect: Cannot use Battlekit requiring 2 hands, and may use only one piece of Battlekit requiring 1 hand.

rows.name: Leg Wound
rows.effect: -2” Movement. -1 DICE to the Risky Success Roll when taking a Dash ACTION.

rows.name: Expensive Treatment
rows.effect: Before deploying this model you must deduct 10 ducats from the Strongbox. The payment does not count toward Threshold Value.

rows.name: Possessed
rows.effect: When Activated more than 1” from any enemy, its first ACTION must be a Dash (even if a rule says it cannot Dash); the first 3” must be in a straight line directly away from its starting position if possible. If Down at start of Activation it stands up if able, then must attempt to move 3” straight away.

rows.name: Muscle Damage
rows.effect: Cannot have Battlekit with HEAVY; any held when the Injury is suffered is lost.

rows.name: Minor Wound
rows.effect: Cannot be used in the next game.

rows.name: Robbed
rows.effect: All Battlekit is lost (except Battlekit that cannot be lost/removed in a campaign). No Injury and no Battle Scar.

rows.name: Full Recovery
rows.effect: No ill effects. No Injury and no Battle Scar.

rows.name: Hardened
rows.effect: Gains NEGATE FEAR. No Injury and no Battle Scar.

rows.name: Bitter Lessons
rows.effect: Gains D3 extra Experience Points. No Injury and no Battle Scar.

rows.name: Prominent Scar
rows.effect: Record the Warband from the game where received. +1 DICE to Melee Attacks by this model against models from that Warband. No Injury and no Battle Scar.

promotions.text: First attempt to Promote Troops (non-ELITE models) to ELITE, then ELITE models use Experience to learn Skills.

pool.text: Promotion Dice Pool = 1D6 + 1D6 per Glorious Deed carried out in the game by any model in the Warband (Troop or not). Some Skills (Show Off) and Glory Items add more dice.

promotions.assignment: Assign pool dice to Troop models that can be Promoted. You cannot assign a 3rd die to a model until all eligible Troops have at least 2, nor a 4th until all have at least 3, and so on. Unassigned dice are lost.
promotions.rolling: Roll a model's assigned dice one at a time in any order; stop at the first 6 and Promote. Track consecutive dice rolled without a 6 on the roster: once the count reaches 5, the next (6th) roll is automatically a 6.
promotions.promotedModel: Gains ELITE immediately (counts as Elite for the rest of this step). Move the entry to the Elite Models section. Starts at 0 Experience Points but gains at least 1 for surviving this game.

maxElites.text: Skip the Promotion step entirely if the Warband already has 6+ ELITE models at the start of the step; stop rolling once a Promotion brings the count to 6. Models with Bad Company do not count toward this total.

experience.text: After Promotions, each ELITE model that took part and survived gains 1 Experience Point (even if taken Out of Action). Any ELITE model that performed at least one Glorious Deed gains a second point (max one extra regardless of Deed count). Record by checking Experience boxes left to right from the top row; reaching a circle box grants an Advancement Roll.

otherSources: Wildcard 11 War Stories: +1 XP to each other ELITE model when recording (one model per warband).
Common Exploration 4 Moonshine Stash (Destroy): +1 XP to up to two ELITE models; Advancement Roll immediately if triggered.
Latecomers: 4 XP per game played by the leading player, split among ELITE models.

steps: Pick two Skill Tables to roll on.
Roll 2D6 on each table to find the Skill offered.
If the rolled Skill is already known, use the next lowest Skill on that table the model lacks; if it has all lower ones, use the next highest.
If a Patron Skill is rolled, use one of the Skills for the Warband's Patron.
Pick one of the two offered Skills and record it.

rules: Troops = models without ELITE.
Promotion Pool: 1D6 + 1D6 per Glorious Deed (+1 per Show Off model, + items).
Dice assignment must be spread evenly (no 3rd die until all have 2, etc.).
5 consecutive non-6 Promotion rolls (tracked across games on the roster) make the 6th automatic.
Maximum 6 ELITE models (Bad Company models excluded from the count).
Head Wound models may receive Promotion Dice as a Troop; a 6 restores XP gain.
Experience: +1 per game survived, +1 if any Glorious Deed; some models capped at 7 XP.
Advancement: 2 tables, 2D6 each, choose one of the two results; duplicate -> next lowest unowned, then next highest.

reinforcements.text: Optional. Call for Reinforcements if losses leave too few models to field a viable Force. Work through the sequence below.
rules: 1. Discard all Battlekit in the Arsenal.
2. Reduce the Strongbox to zero ducats.
3. Calculate the total Cost of all models in the Warband (including Battlekit and ducat-paid upgrades).

4. Subtract that total from the Threshold Value of the next game; the difference is the ducats available to recruit new models (recruited as starting models, with any Battlekit allowed and affordable; may form new Fireteams). Example: 1000 - 635 = 365 ducats.
5. Unspent reinforcement ducats are lost; no Battlekit may be added to the Arsenal (Strongbox and Arsenal start the next game empty).
6. Skip the Exploration Step and Quartermaster Step entirely; go directly to the Roster Step.

exploration.text: Explore the campaign territory for discoveries and loot. Locations are recorded on the roster; each Location can be discovered only once per player (a repeat is a Pillaged result: nothing). Different players may discover the same Location. A roll not on the table discovers nothing but still yields loot. Discovered Battlekit/Glory Items are free and go to the Arsenal, but all normal stipulations (Limits, faction restrictions) still apply; a discovery of ducat-valued Battlekit cannot be used for glory-costed items or vice versa.

sequence.text: Determine the number of Exploration Dice (by games played).
Roll the Exploration Dice and sum them. You may re-roll one die; if you won the game just played you may re-roll one additional die (never the same die twice).
Use Allies (Mercenaries), Equipment and Exploration Skills to modify the Exploration Roll.
Consult the Exploration Table for your games-played bracket (choose Common/Rare or Rare/Legendary before rolling where applicable).
Collect loot equal to 10 x Exploration Roll in ducats, added to the Strongbox.

quartermaster.text: Recruit models, purchase and sell Battlekit and Glory Items, and allocate them to models, in any order and interleaved freely.
rules: Retire Injured Models: any model with 2 Battle Scars may be retired (removed); its Battlekit/Glory Items may be sold or reallocated first, or kept by the retiree.
Hire New Recruits: same rules and restrictions as the Starting Warband; a 0-1 slot freed by a removed model may be refilled.

Purchase Battlekit: spend ducats on ducat-costed Armoury items and glory on glory-costed ones; all Starting Warband stipulations (Limits) apply, counting items in the Arsenal and equipped; removed items free up Limit slots. Restricted items (e.g. ELITE only) may be bought into the Arsenal but only allocated to eligible models.
Sell Battlekit / Glory Items: receive half the Cost, rounding fractions up, in the original currency. Items that cannot be removed from a model cannot be sold.
Purchase Glory Items: spend glory on Glory Items (see Glory Item Tables); they go to the Arsenal or are allocated.

Allocate Battlekit & Glory Items: Arsenal items may be allocated to any eligible model; items may be reallocated between models or back to the Arsenal, subject to eligibility and carrying limits (e.g. no second 2-Handed Weapon without a special rule). Items marked as non-removable cannot be reallocated.
Create New Fireteams: eligible models not already in a Fireteam may form one; a surviving member of a broken Fireteam may form a new one.
Roster Step: bring the Warband Roster up to date.

gloryItems.text: Glory Items are Battlekit purchasable only with glory, only during a campaign, and only once a discovery from an Exploration Table allows them (free, or unlocking purchase up to a glory cap: Trench Merchant 5, Black Market 8, Black Network Contact 12). Each Faction's table lists the Glory Items it may take, with Cost and stipulations, which work like Armoury Table stipulations. Limits count Arsenal plus equipped.

Success/Critical: pick 1 terrain piece within 12” measuring up to 8” by 8”; make an Injury Roll for each model (friend or foe) on or in contact with it, then remove the terrain piece; models on top Fall to the battlefield (extra Injury Roll if 3”+). A Critical's Injury modifier applies only to the first roll; -1 INJURY DICE and IGNORE ARMOUR apply to all.

A Critical's extra INJURY DICE applies only to the first roll.
